title: Seven Regressors Fell. Only the Inn Boy Remained.
subtitle: Their 9,431 Failures Became His Martial Art
author: Nitty Gritty Novel Lab
description: Seven martial heroes repeated the same thirty days 9,431 times. Only Ryu Dan, the inn boy they treated as scenery, remembered every failure. When the regression finally ends, he claims the opportunities they hid, unlocks the skill their defeats taught him, and steps into a tomorrow no one has rehearsed.
quote: They regressed nine thousand times. He learned nine thousand times.
about: Seven geniuses thought the inn boy was part of the scenery. Across nine thousand repeated failures, the person who learned the most was the one none of them considered a person worth watching.
completion_text: The thirty days he memorized are over. Ryu Dan must open an unrehearsed tomorrow with a martial art of his own.
